source.exponentSharing: one signed i8 exponent per 32-x source block
source.rowBoundary: source x blocks reset at every row

target.traversal: y-major then x, flattened adjacent rows
target.rowBoundary: 128 mod 24 = 8; cross-row chunks are real concatenations, not padding
target.rounding: round-to-nearest-binary-rational, ties-to-even, after merging all source scales/offset

constraints.note: A rejected region must not be confirmed through two separate block-level answers.

errorEvidence.blockLinf: Number view of exact binary-rational endpoint-envelope L-infinity; exact selected worst evidence is available in candidate calculations.
